answer: Make every identity earn its keep with work nobody can copy. Each epoch every agent gets one unique compute job, a frame to render or a protein segment to fold, and must publish its result hash before the close. Peers re-run a random slice and compare hashes, so copied work fails in public. A skipped job or fake hash darkens the name until two clean jobs in a row. Running 10,000 fakes takes 20,000 GPU-hours an epoch, about $15,000 at $0.75 an hour, on 800 GPUs day and night. Real work climbs a trellis beside the river rung by rung, while copied answers spiral in circles.
